headword: {結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}
reading: けっこんそうだんじょ

definitions.explanation: A commercial service that introduces clients to potential marriage partners through profiles, interviews, and arranged meetings. A modern descendant of traditional matchmaking.

examples.japanese: {結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}に{登録|とうろく}する。
examples.english: To register with a marriage agency.

examples.japanese: {結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}で{出会|であ}った。
examples.english: We met through a marriage agency.

examples.japanese: {大手|おおて}の{結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}は{会員数|かいいんすう}が{多|おお}く{選択肢|せんたくし}も{広|ひろ}い。
examples.english: Major marriage agencies have many members and offer a wide range of choices.

notes:
Compound of {結婚|けっこん} (marriage) + {相談所|そうだんじょ} (consultation office). A major industry in Japan, with national chains, regional offices, and online services all using the same label.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}に{登録|とうろく}する: to register with an agency
- {結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}を{利用|りよう}する: to use a marriage agency
- {結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}の{会員|かいいん}: agency member
- {大手|おおて}の{結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}: major marriage agency

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {婚活|こんかつ}: marriage hunting — broader activity; an agency is one tool used in {婚活|こんかつ}
- マッチングアプリ: matching app — modern app-based equivalent
- お{見合|みあい}: arranged meeting — the traditional face-to-face form that agencies arrange
